records-data-carriers.title: Records as data carriers
records-data-carriers.summary: Records provide a concise declaration for classes whose main purpose is carrying data.
records-data-carriers.why: The compiler supplies component accessors, a canonical constructor, equals, hashCode, and toString from the record state.
records-data-carriers.tips: Use records when identity is defined by the declared components rather than mutable object state.

base64-encoding.title: Base64 encoding
base64-encoding.summary: Java 8 provides Base64 encoders and decoders in java.util.Base64.
base64-encoding.why: Base64 is useful when binary bytes must travel through text-oriented formats or protocols.
base64-encoding.tips: Base64 is encoding, not encryption; use the matching basic, URL, or MIME variant for the surrounding format.

map-getordefault-fallback.title: Map fallback with getOrDefault
map-getordefault-fallback.short: Read a map value with a default
map-getordefault-fallback.summary: Map.getOrDefault returns the mapped value or a supplied fallback when the key has no mapping.
map-getordefault-fallback.why: It expresses simple lookup fallback without a separate containsKey branch.
map-getordefault-fallback.tips: Remember that a key explicitly mapped to null is different from an absent key for some map operations.

stream-tolist-unmodifiable-result.title: Collect a stream with toList
stream-tolist-unmodifiable-result.short: Create an unmodifiable list from a stream
stream-tolist-unmodifiable-result.summary: Stream.toList returns a list containing the stream elements and the returned list is unmodifiable.
stream-tolist-unmodifiable-result.why: It is concise when later structural mutation is not required.
stream-tolist-unmodifiable-result.tips: Use an explicit mutable collection when callers need add or remove operations.

integer-parseint-numberformat.title: Invalid integer text
integer-parseint-numberformat.summary: Integer.parseInt throws NumberFormatException when the text is not a valid int representation or is out of range.
integer-parseint-numberformat.why: Text input is not guaranteed to satisfy the numeric format and range expected by int.
integer-parseint-numberformat.tips: Validate or handle NumberFormatException at input boundaries.

list-of-null-npe.title: Null element in List.of
list-of-null-npe.summary: List.of throws NullPointerException when any supplied element is null.
list-of-null-npe.why: The immutable collection factory contracts disallow null elements.
list-of-null-npe.tips: Remove or represent missing values explicitly before constructing the list.

record-extends-class-error.title: Record extending a class
record-extends-class-error.summary: A record cannot use extends to inherit from an ordinary class.
record-extends-class-error.why: Every record already has java.lang.Record as its direct superclass.
record-extends-class-error.tips: Records may implement interfaces when shared behavior contracts are needed.

pattern-variable-out-of-scope.title: Pattern variable outside its scope
pattern-variable-out-of-scope.short: Pattern variables exist only where the match is known
pattern-variable-out-of-scope.summary: An instanceof pattern variable cannot be used after control flow leaves the region where the successful match is guaranteed.
pattern-variable-out-of-scope.why: The compiler tracks flow-sensitive scope so the variable only exists where its type test has succeeded.
pattern-variable-out-of-scope.tips: Keep uses inside the matching branch or restructure the control flow.

rawtypes-generic-type-warning.title: Raw generic type
rawtypes-generic-type-warning.summary: Using a generic class as a raw type discards compile-time type information and can produce unchecked warnings.
rawtypes-generic-type-warning.why: Raw types exist mainly for compatibility with pre-generics code and weaken type safety.
rawtypes-generic-type-warning.tips: Use parameterized types such as List<String>, or an appropriate wildcard when the element type is intentionally unknown.

optional-orelse-eager-evaluation.title: Eager Optional.orElse fallback
optional-orelse-eager-evaluation.short: orElse evaluates its fallback even when present
optional-orelse-eager-evaluation.summary: The argument to Optional.orElse is evaluated before the method call, even when the Optional already contains a value.
optional-orelse-eager-evaluation.why: An expensive or side-effecting fallback can therefore run unnecessarily.
optional-orelse-eager-evaluation.tips: Use orElseGet with a supplier when fallback creation should be lazy.
